text: dsh-music-player 是面向 DSH 网页端的音乐播放器插件，通过侧边栏入口打开播放器面板，并由浏览器音频播放 Audius 曲目。用户可搜索曲目、浏览趋势曲目、收藏歌曲并控制播放队列；Agent 也可通过音乐工具搜索和遥控网页播放器。使用时需要打开 DSH 网页，插件向 Audius 公共 API 请求曲目与音频流；代码未读取 API 密钥。

dsh-music-player adds Audius playback to the DSH web client. Open it from the sidebar to search and play tracks, browse trends, save favorites, and manage a queue. Agent tools can search and control playback. Keep the web page open; requests and audio streams use Audius APIs, and no API key is read.
想在 DSH 网页里搜歌并直接播放。
让 DSH 的 Agent 帮我找一首歌并控制网页播放器。
I want to browse trending tracks and play them inside the DSH web page.
dsh-music-player 的功能「搜索并播放音乐」：在网页播放器面板输入关键词后搜索 Audius 曲目，选择结果即可加入播放并使用网页音频播放。
dsh-music-player 使用前须知：搜索、趋势和曲目请求及音频流均使用 api.audius.co；所读代码未读取 API 密钥。（见 src/audiusApi.ts:9-10,65-83）

dsh-music-player README · dsh-music-player：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A music player plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) web profile: search and stream music from **Audius** (a legal, free, open music platform), right inside the dsh web UI — and control it from the agent chat.

dsh-music-player README · ⚡ One-line install：**Feed this to your AI** (any AI with command execution will do, no explanation needed):

> Install dsh-music-player: run `dsh plugin --profile web add github:hey-ruomei/dsh-music-player`, then restart `dsh web`.

**Or run the command directly:**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:hey-ruomei/dsh-music-player && dsh web
```

> No `prepare` build script; `lib/` ships prebuilt, so git installs need zero extra build steps. Restart dsh after installing.

dsh-music-player README · Features：- **Sidebar entry** — a music button above Settings in the left sidebar opens the player panel
- **Search the Audius library** — debounced search over hundreds of thousands of free tracks
- **Trending** — browse the Audius trending chart without searching
- **Favorites** — heart any track; stored in localStorage, survives restarts
- **Play queue** — click any row in Search / Trending / Favorites to start playing from it
- **Mini player bar** — closing the panel keeps music playing; a floating bar in the bottom-right corner keeps controls handy
- **Agent remote control** — four agent tools let you drive the player from chat:

dsh-music-player README · Features：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `music_search` | Search Audius, returns top 5 tracks (title / artist / duration / id) |
| `music_play` | Play a track by `trackId`, or the top match of a `query` |
| `music_control` | `pause` / `resume` / `next` / `prev` / `set_volume` (0–1) |
| `music_status` | Report what's currently playing |

Just say "play some jazz" in the chat — the agent searches, queues, and your browser starts playing.

dsh-music-player README · Notes：- **The dsh web page must be open** for playback (audio plays in the browser). If the page is closed, `music_play` / `music_control` return a clear error instead of silently queueing.
- Audius is a decentralized upload platform: some tracks may fail to stream because their content node is down or the upload was removed. The player skips to the next track on failure and stops after 3 consecutive failures.
- All Audius requests carry `app_name=dsh-music-player` per the API's terms.

dsh-music-player README · Architecture：```
agent chat ── tools ──▶ node half (/api/music command queue + status heartbeat)
                            ▲ poll 1.5s / report 3s
browser client ◀────────────┘  module-level <audio> + PlayerStore
```

Built entirely on official mechanisms (bundle layer stack + `webServer` routes + `dsh.client` slots) — no patches to official packages. Node half is ESM; client half is CJS wrapped in the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` contract.

dsh-music-player README · Develop / rebuild from source：```sh
pnpm install    # tsdown / react / vitest
pnpm build      # emits lib/index.mjs + lib/index.js
pnpm test       # vitest unit tests
```

`tsdown.config.ts` is self-contained (no official monorepo preset).
